customer_reply:
Hello,

Thank you for contacting us. The error E-3310 your suppliers are seeing when submitting bids is caused by a change to the buyer tenant SAML/SSO configuration that was not followed by an update to the supplier portal trust relationship, causing supplier session tokens to be rejected at bid submit.

Please follow the resolution steps from KB-4795:

1. Confirm the buyer tenant SSO/SAML configuration changed recently (Admin > Security > SSO history).
2. Follow KB-7889 to re-establish the supplier portal trust relationship (Admin > Security > SSO, download SAML metadata; Admin > Supplier Portal > Trust Settings, upload metadata; select Re-issue Supplier Session Keys; ask affected suppliers to sign in again and retry).
3. Ask the supplier to sign out, clear the session and resubmit the bid.
4. Since the RFx closes within 48 hours, we recommend extending the event deadline now to protect bid fairness while the trust relationship is re-established.

If the resolution steps fail, more than 50 records are affected, or the issue occurs on multiple tenants, please reply and we will escalate to L2 Engineering. When escalating, please include the tenant ID, affected record ID, exact error text, and time of failure in UTC.

Best regards,
Technical Support Team
